scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,syncstart,realtime,frontend --prefix-colors blue,yellow,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:syncstart" "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:dependencies: docker compose up --detach --wait postgres redis migrations
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --workspace=@tournament-manager/api -- --runInBand && npm run test:e2e --workspace=@tournament-manager/migrations
scripts.verify: npm run check:architecture && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:contract && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.local:up: docker compose build api && docker compose up --build --detach --wait --remove-orphans
scripts.local_sync:up: npm run local:up && npm run local_sync:bridge
scripts.local_sync:bridge: npm run build --workspace=@tournament-manager/legacy-syncstart-bridge && npm run start --workspace=@tournament-manager/legacy-syncstart-bridge
scripts.local:reset: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && npm run local:up
scripts.verify:local: npm run build && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && node scripts/verify-local.mjs
